name: Sébium Foaming Gel
desc: A purifying foaming cleanser for oily, acne-prone skin that removes excess sebum without over-drying.
longDesc: A gentle-yet-effective foaming cleanser designed specifically for oily and acne-prone skin. It clears away excess sebum and impurities while its Fluidactiv complex works to regulate oil production over time, helping reduce shine and the recurrence of blemishes without stripping the skin barrier.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: For patients with oily, acne-prone skin, this is my go-to recommendation when a foaming cleanser is appropriate. It clears excess oil effectively without the over-drying rebound that often worsens acne in the long run.

name: Atoderm Cream
desc: A rich, fast-absorbing body and face cream that restores comfort to very dry, fragile skin.
longDesc: A rich, ultra-nourishing cream that replenishes lipids in very dry to extremely dry skin. Its patented AtoDerm complex helps restore the skin's protective barrier, reducing tightness and discomfort within days of regular use, and is suitable for use on both face and body, including for sensitive and reactive skin.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: Patients with chronic dryness or barrier-compromised skin consistently report real relief with Atoderm within the first week. It's rich without feeling occlusive, and I often pair it with gentler cleansers for eczema-prone patients.

name: Node Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
desc: A soothing shampoo that reduces flaking and scalp irritation with regular use.
longDesc: A soothing, frequent-use shampoo that gently cleanses the scalp while reducing flaking and the itch-scratch cycle associated with dandruff. Free from harsh sulfates, it's gentle enough for daily use while remaining effective against persistent scalp flaking.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A well-tolerated option for patients who need frequent washing but still deal with flaking — I recommend it particularly for those who find medicated shampoos too harsh for daily use.

name: Pigmentbio Foaming Cream
desc: A brightening cleanser with gentle exfoliating microbeads that evens tone and fades dark spots over time.
longDesc: A brightening foaming cleanser formulated for skin with dark spots and uneven tone. Soluble microbeads gently exfoliate while a patented combination of active ingredients works to unify and illuminate the complexion, without compromising the sensitive skin barrier.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A good first step for patients tackling post-inflammatory dark spots who also need a cleanser gentle enough for reactive skin — the exfoliation is mild enough not to aggravate sensitivity.

name: Atoderm Intensive Baume
desc: An ultra-soothing balm that restores comfort to irritated skin with an atopic tendency.
longDesc: An intensive, ultra-soothing balm designed for irritated skin with an atopic tendency. It restores and replenishes the skin's lipid barrier while calming itching, making it well suited to daily use on very dry, reactive areas prone to flare-ups.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: I recommend this balm for patients managing atopic-tendency skin day to day — it's rich enough to calm active itching but still comfortable enough for regular use, not just flare-ups.

name: Blemish Control Cleanser
desc: An oil-absorbing foaming gel cleanser with 3 essential ceramides, salicylic acid and niacinamide for blemish-prone skin.
longDesc: A gel cleanser that dispenses clear and transforms into a foam as you lather, formulated with 3 essential ceramides, 2% salicylic acid and niacinamide. Its oil-absorbing technology and hectorite clay unclog pores and reduce excess shine, while visibly reducing blackheads and breakouts in as little as one week, without disrupting the skin barrier.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A well-balanced option for blemish-prone skin — the salicylic acid and clay handle excess oil while the ceramides keep the barrier from getting stripped, which is where a lot of acne cleansers go wrong.

name: Mela B3 Serum
desc: An intensive concentrate that targets dark spots and helps prevent them from recurring.
longDesc: An intensive anti-dark spot concentrate built around La Roche-Posay's patented Melasyl molecule, paired with 10% niacinamide to visibly fade discoloration and interrupt the recurrence cycle that makes dark spots so persistent. Formulated to be gentle enough for regular use even on reactive skin.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: Melasyl is one of the more interesting molecules to come out in pigmentation care recently — I've seen it hold up well for patients whose dark spots kept coming back despite other treatments.

name: Mela B3 Cleanser
desc: A clarifying micro-peeling gel cleanser that gently exfoliates to even out skin tone.
longDesc: A daily micro-peeling gel cleanser that pairs gentle PHA exfoliation with Melasyl and niacinamide to unify skin tone from the very first step of a routine. Rinses clean without stripping, making it a suitable pairing for the Mela B3 Serum.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: A nice way to introduce gentle exfoliation into a pigmentation routine without overdoing it — PHA is one of the more forgiving acids for patients who've reacted to stronger exfoliants before.

name: Anthelios UVmune 400 Fluide Invisible SPF 50+
desc: An invisible, ultra-light sunscreen fluid with extended UVA protection and SPF 50+.
longDesc: Built on La Roche-Posay's next-generation Mexoryl 400 filter system, this fluid extends protection further into the long-UVA range than standard sunscreens — the wavelengths most linked to premature aging and pigmentation. The invisible, non-greasy finish sits comfortably under makeup.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: The extended long-UVA coverage is the real story here — most sunscreens undersell that range, and it's a significant factor in the pigmentation and aging patients ask me about most.

name: Anthelios UVmune 400 Oil Control Fluide SPF 50+
desc: A mattifying SPF 50+ fluid with extended UVA protection, formulated for oily and blemish-prone skin.
longDesc: The same next-generation Mexoryl 400 UVA filter system as the original UVmune 400 fluid, reformulated with oil-absorbing technology for a matte, shine-free finish — built for oily and blemish-prone skin that still needs serious daily sun protection without breaking out.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Glycerin, and other formulation-specific actives as listed by the manufacturer. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; this is placeholder demo text.)
doctorOpinion: My go-to recommendation for oily and acne-prone patients who avoid sunscreen because it feels heavy — this stays matte through the day, which is often the difference between a patient using SPF daily or not at all.

name: Hydrating Cleanser
desc: A gentle, low-foam cleanser with three ceramides and hyaluronic acid that cleanses without leaving normal-to-dry and sensitive skin feeling tight.
longDesc: A foundation cleanser built around a simple philosophy: gentle cleansing plus hydration and barrier support, not a long list of trendy actives. Its creamy, low-foam texture removes daily grime and makeup residue without the stripped, tight after-feel that many cleansers leave behind, thanks to three essential ceramides, hyaluronic acid, glycerin, cholesterol and phytosphingosine.

doctorOpinion: My go-to foundation cleanser for patients who don't want their cleanser fighting their skin — gentle, barrier-focused, and non-comedogenic enough that it works even on sensitive, reactive skin.

info.category: Sunscreen — Oily / Combination, Matte Silicone Gel

name: Tinted Ivory Sunscreen SPF 50
desc: A tinted SPF 50 PA+++ sunscreen mousse that provides UV protection with light complexion-evening coverage.
longDesc: The key advantage here isn't simply SPF — it's the tint. A lightweight tinted silicone texture blends into skin for a cosmetic, complexion-evening finish, giving customers a way to combine sun protection with light coverage in one step, without needing foundation underneath.
fullIngredients: Aqua/Water, Titanium Dioxide, Zinc Oxide, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, and other formulation-specific ingredients. (Full INCI ingredient list is provided on the physical product packaging; verify before publishing.)
doctorOpinion: A useful addition for patients who want sunscreen plus a light complexion correction in one step — just not a substitute for a properly tinted, visible-light-tested sunscreen in significant melasma.

info.whySelected: The key advantage isn't simply SPF — it's the tint. This gives a separate category for customers who want sun protection plus slight complexion correction/coverage, useful addition to a tinted-sunscreen lineup.
bestFor: Normal, combination and mildly oily skin
Customers who prefer a tinted sunscreen
Customers wanting to reduce the appearance of uneven complexion
notFirstChoiceFor: Very oily skin wanting a strong matte/oil-control sunscreen
Very dry skin without moisturizer underneath
Customers needing a very specific match to their skin tone

ingredientTech.description: Mineral UV filter, also contributes to the tint's coverage.

pros: Can simplify a routine for customers who don't want foundation
Useful addition to a tinted-sunscreen lineup
thingsToKnow: PA+++ rather than PA++++
Ivory shade may not suit every skin tone
Tint should not be confused with a dedicated pigmentation treatment — for significant melasma, prefer a tinted sunscreen with documented visible-light protection
howToUse: Apply generously and evenly to the face before sun exposure, blending as you would a light foundation.
Reapply regularly during outdoor exposure.
